patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; Uniqode is narrower/specialist.

Frame: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; Uniqode is narrower/specialist.. Choose LearnWorlds only if your buying job matches “AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.” rather than Uniqode's shape. Choose Uniqode only if your buying job matches “Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR;” rather than LearnWorlds's shape. Workflow advantage: LearnWorlds leans creator-marketing, funnel-building; Uniqode leans content-marketing. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; Uniqode is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: LearnWorlds is AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.; Uniqode is Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free static QR; paid dynamic from researched ~$9/mo floor..
- Workflow coverage skew: LearnWorlds-leaning creator-marketing, funnel-building, multichannel-campaigns vs Uniqode-leaning content-marketing.
- Researched limits: LearnWorlds — Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Uniqode — Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite.

Limitations — LearnWorlds: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Active learner and admin caps by plan; Uniqode: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite; Plan cards hard to verify without live checkout.

Poor-fit cases: LearnWorlds is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment · Uniqode is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Specialist QR/digital card tool — not a full marketing suite · Avoid LearnWorlds if you actually need Uniqode's motion (Dynamic QR codes and digital business cards for offline→online campaigns — free )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
